title: Team Leader - Field Sales
description:
This job is provided by apna.co We are hiring Team Leader \- Filed Sales
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead, guide, and supervise a team of marketing executives by planning daily field activities, setting targets, providing on\-ground support, and ensuring consistent performance and discipline.
* Drive individual productivity during the first 3 months with 5 client meetings/presentations per day.
* Visit business owners to onboard and manage client details on the Justdial platform and present services effectively.
* Understand client needs and recommend suitable Justdial products while building strong customer relationships and brand presence.
* Post 3 months, manage both individual and team productivity, ensuring overall target achievement.
* Once the team is assigned, complete 3 client presentations daily as an individual target \+ team handling


**Requirements**
 Good communication and selling skills.
   

  

 Two\-wheeler with valid license preferred.
   

  

 Freshers or experienced can apply.
   

  

 Basic Android/Mobile app knowledge.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Medical Insurance Coverage with GPA Coverage
   

  

 Gratuity Benefits
   

  

 Salary \- 3\.6LPA \- 5\.5LPA \+ incentives \+ addon bonus
   

  

 Experience \- Experienced candidates can apply
   

  

 Job locations \- Ernakulam, Aluva, Muvattupuzha, Kozhikode, Kannur, Malapuram
   

  

 HR details \- Rincy Charley(HR)
   

  

 Contact \- 9961977880 \& rincy.charley@justdial.com
